title: Bluestar — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Bluestar.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Luxury tier. BlueStar is for the cook who wants restaurant-grade power at home. They are one of the only residential range brands offering open burners — the same setup used in professional kitchens for maximum heat and responsiveness. 25,000 BTU burners, interchangeable griddle and charbroiler, and over 750 custom color options including any Pantone color. BlueStar ranges are handcrafted in Reading, Pennsylvania.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Serious home cooks, chef-owned kitchens, design projects where a custom color range is the centerpiece. Food bloggers and cooking enthusiasts.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Bluestar:

• Open burners — same as professional kitchens, maximum heat responsiveness

• 25,000 BTU — highest output residential burner available

• 750+ custom colors including any Pantone — your customer picks the exact shade

• Handcrafted in Reading, PA — not mass-produced, each unit built to order

• Interchangeable griddle and charbroiler drop into the range top — restaurant versatility at home
